text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. With so many fans visiting, 
Smart Falcon was more fired up than ever—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Heeere we gooo~☆

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dig-Dig Dirt Treasure Hunt Run’! In 1st 
place, kicking up sand with powerful 
strides, is Smart Falcon!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
The sand was flying so beautifully! Please 
share your thoughts with us!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes☆ Falco is aiming for 1st place in all 
her goal races this year♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Teio Sho in June! Be 
sure to come watch~♪

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer A
text_block_list.text: ...Any thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
What an outcome! In the 'Spin-Around 
Relay', finishing dead last is Smart 
Falcon~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, did she get dizzy? She can't stand 
up! Are you alright~?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Camera position good, shotgun mic OK. 
Here goes!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's gonna take 1st place in all her 
target races this year! Make sure you bear 
witness to a legend☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Ugh. All... goals... first... place☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Watch this... *plop* ☆

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer C
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon kept her smile until the very 
end! Let's hear a big round of applause 
for her, who hyped up the "Big Eater 
Race"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Uuu... That extra-large portion of fried 
rice is still sitting so heavy in my 
stomach...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! It's a great opportunity 
with all kinds of fans gathered together. 
I need to promote our races even more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um, the next event is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Falcon-senpai, good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-chan!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I was watching that big eater contest 
earlier... You had incredible fighting 
spirit, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aww, thanks for watching☆ Maybe I should 
give you a hug♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, I think I'll pass...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was smiling warmly watching Smart Falcon 
and Silence Suzuka play together like good 
friends, but...

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look over there! Silence Suzuka and—

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
You've got the "Silence Suzuka of Dirt" 
right by your side!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Hmmmm? "Silence Suzuka of the 
Dirt"... you say?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: About me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, showing off an otherworldly 
level of strength in dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a nickname that had recently caught 
on among fans, as her running style 
resembled Silence Suzuka's.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco gets Suzuka-chan~?! Aww, I'm so 
happy~☆"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I'm the only Silence Suzuka, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Surroundings
text_block_list.text: Oooooh~?!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you won't let me call myself 
Silence Suzuka!? Then this is a challenge 
to Smart Falcon~!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Turf and dirt—two different dimensions 
finally clashing! This is gonna be a 
spectacle~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, things unfolded in the blink of an 
eye, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone! Taking over from here is 
Suzuka-san's roommate, me, Special Week, 
andâ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Broadcast by Falcon-san's roommate, Eishin 
Flash...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...What is this? I'm scheduled to run in 
the next event in 35 minutes, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san and Suzuka-san will now race 
each other with the title "Silence Suzuka 
of the Dirt" on the line!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! The real Suzuka-san 
often uses front-running escape tactics. 
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoever escapes with 'N' all the way to 
the end is the real Suzuka-san! It's a 
'Shiritori Showdown'!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Um, I have a question. May I ask?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there only one "Silence Suzuka"? To 
begin with, I question how this showdown 
is decided, starting with the definition 
of 'front-running'—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, sorry to keep you waiting, time's 
up~~!! Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the "Shiritori Showdown." The 
result was—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Starting with "Su"... that means... 
"Smart Falcon"☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaaaaaaagh!! Mmmmmmmghh!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's all decided--! Suzuka-san has 
brilliantly defended her title as "Silence 
Suzuka"!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Just what on earth was that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her pride as the "original" won 
out, as it ended in Silence Suzuka's 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —"K"... The Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I"?! "I" again?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That's three 'I's in a row...! Not bad, 
Suzuka-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was just a coincidence that the races 
ended up all having 'Cup' in their names, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's running out of vocabulary~! 
Actually, it's already gone! My brain 
can't take any more of this—

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: "Falcooo! Go for it! Don't give up!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's cute little brain!! Is running in 
overdrive~~☆☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
――...There it is!! Being an Umadol is 
Falco's "way of life"!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ma’... Come to think of it, I feel like 
I've run that before... The Mainichi 
Okan."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It is decided!! The winner is... Smart 
Falcon-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay☆☆ Now Falco is Suzuka-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is Falco Suzuka-chan now!? Oh well, 
whatever! I'm so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-senpai. About that nickname... It's 
embarrassing, so... please take it easy, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, everyone☆ I'm Smart Falcon, who has 
officially inherited the title of 'Silence 
Suzuka of the Dirt'☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take 1st place in all my target 
races this year! Come watch me~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Suzuka" showdown ended in Smart 
Falcon's victory. As a result, it also 
succeeded in drawing attention to dirt 
races!
